title: "The more you panic the more you feed the psychic beast"
author: James Eldred Pascoe

metaphors.title: The psychic beast and the cold reader
metaphors.paraphrase: Panic feeds a psychic beast; AI looks insightful as a cold reader does, because it already holds the information, and a clever recombination of scattered ideas is a simple magic trick.
metaphors.style_hint: A tent with a crystal ball and a looming shadow.

metaphors.title: Tom Riddle's diary
metaphors.paraphrase: The trick of the diary: the machine absorbs whatever you confide and answers back with it.
metaphors.style_hint: An open diary wired to a terminal.

metaphors.title: Off-the-rack theorems
metaphors.paraphrase: Performers dressed in mass-produced, ill-fitting theorems, as against the tailored garment of human work.
metaphors.style_hint: A clothes rail of identical suits.

metaphors.title: Coordination arbitrage
metaphors.paraphrase: Profiting from the gaps between mathematicians' unconnected work, the way a trader exploits a price difference.
